notes: CourtListener phrase counts, Nov. 25, 2026. The per curiam's 'heavy presumption' and 'heavy burden' language quotes Bantam Books (1963) and Keefe (1971), so it was not scored as pre-existing language; Harlan scored by 'almost irresponsibly feverish' (his 'Great cases' line quotes Holmes).
